verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page claims users can keep work up to date by tracking progress from tools like Figma with AI assistance (jira-docs-2), and that Rovo AI connects Figma assets to Jira work (jira-docs-18). That is a first-party capability aimed directly at this story, but it rests on a single marketing line with no detail on how status updates happen inside Figma. Missing for 10: documentation of the Figma integration mechanics (in-tool status changes or transitions without leaving Figma), coverage of design tools beyond Figma, and independent or hands-on corroboration that designers can update status this way.
